ChordFinder.title: Chord Finder
ChordFinder.intro: Place notes on the fretboard the way you'd press them on your guitar. Each string holds one note; click again to remove. Use the string panel on the left to mark a string as open (○) or muted (×).

matches.empty: Click frets on the fretboard to place notes. The chord name will appear here as soon as the notes form a recognizable chord.
matches.noMatch: No chord matches those notes. Try adding or removing a note.
